The scene should be dark and atmospheric, with heavy glass reflections, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, and out-of-focus city bokeh lights in red, white, yellow, cyan, and blue. Cover the subject's face with one large opaque square censor block, centered over the head and upper torso area, colored deep charcoal blue-gray, with sharp clean edges and no text. In the background, include a glowing blurry cyan-blue neon sign near the upper left that vaguely resembles letters but remains unreadable, plus vertical window frames and dark bus interior structure. title: 华丽的中国新娘肖像

prompt_en: Create a close-up vertical portrait of a young East Asian woman in an elaborate ancient Chinese bridal or palace style, wearing a translucent ivory hanfu robe and an extremely ornate gold phoenix-style hair crown with dangling chains, pearls, red gemstones, floral filigree, and bead tassels. Her dark brown hair is styled half-up in a polished traditional updo with long loose strands falling over the shoulders. The face is intentionally hidden by one centered opaque square censor block in a warm skin-tone gradient, covering the entire facial feature area from forehead to chin while leaving the hairline, ears, neck, jewelry, and shoulders visible. Include exactly 3 prominent red oval gemstones on the headdress, many small pearl drops, and 2 long dangling earring ornaments visible beside the neck. Use warm golden sunlight, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic bokeh, and a blurred red-and-gold palace interior background. The mood should feel luxurious, romantic, and hyper-realistic, with crisp detail on the jewelry and fabric, natural skin on the neck and shoulders, and no visible text, watermark, or modern objects.\

title: 池畔学校清洁场景
author: ギン
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,群像 / 情侣,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en: Create a photorealistic vertical summer snapshot of three Japanese high school girls cleaning an outdoor school swimming pool area on a bright sunny day, styled like a nostalgic candid youth magazine photo. The scene is poolside on wet concrete with the blue pool and metal fence in the background, leafy greenery and a pale blue sky with soft clouds behind them. All faces should be anonymized with soft square mosaic blur blocks, matching a privacy-blurred social-media photo. The students wear matching summer school uniforms: crisp white short-sleeve button-up shirts, navy striped neckties, and blue plaid pleated skirts, barefoot on the wet ground. Count exactly 3 students: the left student stands holding a blue garden hose spraying water onto the pavement and carries a navy shoulder bag with a small plush keychain; the center student leans forward toward the camera while scrubbing the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush; the right student stands confidently with one hand on her hip while holding a plastic cup of bubble tea with a red straw. Include exactly 5 main cleaning/accessory items: 1 blue hose with visible splashing water, 1 long-handled brush with green bristles, 1 turquoise bucket on the right foreground, 1 white towel draped over the bucket edge, and 1 drink cup with tapioca pearls. Use natural sunlight, realistic water reflections, sparkling droplets, shallow depth of field, soft lens flare, and a small rainbow reflection near the bottom foreground. Composition should be full-body, slightly low eye-level, portrait 9:16, centered on the middle student and framed to show the poolside environment. Keep the mood wholesome, casual, cheerful, and summery; avoid text, logos, exaggerated poses, or fantasy elements.\

Use cinematic concert photography, shallow depth of field, high detail fabric textures, glossy leather, glittering rhinestones, energetic pop-star atmosphere, realistic skin and lighting, shot from a slightly low angle as if by a professional stage photographer. title: Codex 拼图技术横幅
author: 向阳乔木
categories: 应用 / 网页设计,信息图 / 教育视觉,极简主义,3D 渲染,图解 / 图表,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a wide editorial hero banner about Codex的下一块拼图, showing a jigsaw-puzzle metaphor for AI coding, visual design, and missing capabilities.

Canvas: Ultra-wide horizontal banner, approximately 5:2 aspect ratio, dark charcoal technical background with faint grid lines, subtle blueprint marks, tiny dots, and thin circuit-like guide lines. Center the artwork with a large off-white paper/cardboard jigsaw puzzle assembly casting soft shadows.

Layout: Use exactly 15 visible puzzle elements: 13 off-white connected puzzle pieces forming a rectangular mosaic, 1 vivid cobalt-blue puzzle piece inserted at the bottom-right edge, and 1 dashed-outline empty missing-piece slot immediately to the right of the blue piece. The puzzle should look physical, with rounded tabs and sockets, slight bevels, paper texture, seams, grime, and realistic shadowing.

Text content: The main typography dominates the puzzle surface. Use huge bold black sans-serif Chinese type reading Codex的 across the top row and 下一块拼图 across the middle row. Make the letters oversized, cropped slightly by puzzle seams, and integrated into the tile layout. Keep the text crisp and high contrast.

Visible graphic elements: Include exactly 7 small embedded UI/diagram motifs on puzzle pieces: 1 dark code editor panel in the lower-left with short colored code lines and a small </> symbol; 1 pie chart combined with a small bar chart along the lower middle; 1 simple node-and-connector flow diagram near the lower center-right; 1 bullet-list panel with three round bullets to the right of the flow diagram; 1 user profile card in the upper-right with avatar icon and horizontal text lines; 1 small spreadsheet/dashboard grid in the top-right corner with gray cells and one blue highlighted cell; 1 document/image card on the right side with small mountain thumbnail lines, overlapped by a blue chat bubble containing two white dots and two white horizontal lines.

Visual style: Premium tech editorial illustration, cinematic lighting, tactile paper puzzle texture, muted monochrome palette of black, warm off-white, gray, and accent cobalt blue cobalt blue. Add subtle scratches, dust, and paper grain. Use realistic shadows between pieces, but keep the whole image clean and readable.

Constraints: No people, no extra logos, no watermark, no random English words beyond tiny unreadable code strokes, and no additional large text. The blue puzzle piece should feel like the key missing component that completes the system, while the dashed empty slot hints that another piece is still absent.\

prompt_en:
Create a high-contrast, cinematic graphic design poster inspired by the TV series 'Breaking Bad'. Use a 2x6 vertical grid to display 12 iconic character cards. Blend urban graffiti with crime thriller aesthetics, utilizing worn textures, film grain, and bold sans-serif font mask effects.

Each card features character names like 'Walter', 'Jesse', and 'Saul' highlighted in large font, with character portraits visible only within the filled text (clipping mask effect). Beneath the names, place concise movie subtitles like 'Mafia Boss', 'Lawyer', and 'Gunman'.

Overlay heavy ink splashes, paint drips, brushstrokes, scratches, scanlines, dust, film burns, and grain to achieve a distorted cinematic feel. The palette uses deep green, toxic fluorescent green, grayscale, dark charcoal, dirty yellow, and off-white, complemented by a green glow behind Walter, red-orange behind Tuco, blue crystals around Jesse, and pure white around Lydia.

Final result conveys the effect of a high-end Netflix crime series cast poster, featuring a raw, edgy, and highly stylized graphic design aesthetic.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean horizontal lighting comparison sheet titled LIGHTING RESPONSE TESTS, showing the same futuristic fashion model under five different studio lighting setups.

Canvas: Wide 16:7 presentation board on a light gray-white background, minimalist editorial layout, thin white gutters between image panels, subtle black border along the bottom edge.

Layout: Place the title in the upper left in uppercase black sans-serif letters. Below it, arrange exactly 5 equal vertical portrait panels from left to right, each containing the same full-body front-facing female model standing centered. Under each panel, add a two-line caption with the setup name in uppercase and the color temperature or color note below it.

Subject details: The model is a tall slender woman with a neutral symmetrical pose, arms relaxed at her sides, hair pulled back, face intentionally softly blurred or featureless. She wears a glossy iridescent translucent couture gown: high collar, sleeveless sculpted metallic bodice, reflective liquid-plastic surface, long sheer cape-like skirt panels flowing to the floor, pearlescent silver-white fabric with strong specular highlights. Keep the outfit identical in all five panels; only the lighting and background tones change.

Five lighting panels, exactly:
1. SOFTBOX — Daylight / 5600K: bright high-key white studio background, soft even daylight, pale pearly reflections.
2. RIM LIGHT — Cool / 6500K: dark blue-gray background, cool blue rim light outlining the model and dress edges, icy highlights.
3. GOLDEN HOUR — Warm / 3200K: warm beige-brown background, amber golden illumination, soft sunset glow through the translucent skirt.
4. NEON CITY — Cyan / Magenta: dark urban blue background, strong cyan light from one side and magenta-pink light from the other, vibrant neon reflections across the gown.

Left section “FACE TYPE”: large Japanese face type text “ソフトエレガント”, a short Japanese description about a balanced face with elegance and softness, and exactly 4 small hashtag chips: “# 大人顔”, “# 曲線寄りの直線”, “# 上品”, “# 華やか”.

prompt_en:

Night Lighting

Person/Expression:
woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige white skin with a smooth texture containing a hint of pink. ivory-beige draped dress. Thin halter straps, deep V-line, wrap-style fabric flowing from chest to waist, small ring hardware at the side of the waist, modest side cuts, long skirt with a natural slit. Thin black strap heels, delicate necklace, and small earrings. Sitting on a wooden staircase with legs gracefully crossed. high-end Japanese ryokan hotel interior at night. Dark wood-grain stairs, wooden railings on both sides, lattice reminiscent of shoji in the back with small lanterns, and modest branch decorations. Vertical 4:5, full-body Japanese portrait. Subject is slightly below the center of the screen, with the staircase depth continuing behind. Camera is at a slightly low angle, front-facing, with a medium telephoto compression feel. Focus on the face and upper body, with a lightly blurred background. Include the toes, guiding the viewer's gaze toward the subject via the lines of light on the stairs.

Texture/Style:
High-quality Japanese photography style. Indoor night portrait, moist wood texture, natural skin texture, soft clumps of hair, and careful depiction of fabric weight and drape. Color tone unified in amber, ivory, and dark brown. Avoid excessive HDR or overly strong sharpness, aiming for a calm magazine-style finish.

Minor, infantilization, vulgar exposure, transparent clothing, dew point, excessive sexual suggestion, unnatural face or gaze, extra or missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, collapsed toes, poor contact with tools or stairs, floating sensation, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with light sources, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, excessive HDR, garbled characters, logos, watermarks, unnecessary people or objects.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cute Japanese perfume advertising flyer for an original tomato-cat fragrance, like a soft commercial poster for a kawaii cosmetic brand. Use TOMATONYAN as the perfume name and keep the overall feeling warm, sweet, and slightly premium.

Canvas: Wide horizontal flyer, 16:9 aspect ratio, divided into a large left hero advertisement panel and a narrower right information panel. Background is warm cream with peach tones, soft sunlight, shallow depth of field, blurred tomato vines and greenery around the edges, and a clean magazine-layout finish.

Main left hero panel: Feature exactly 2 main tomato-cat characters in the center-left area: 1 glossy red tomato cat sitting on a round glass perfume bottle, and 1 larger tomato cat wearing a pale cream hoodie with cat ears. Both characters have tomato stems as leafy hair, tiny black glossy eyes, small white mouths, blush cheeks, and cute rounded bodies. The perfume bottle is transparent glass with pale peach liquid, a tomato-shaped red cap/character head, and white branding text reading “TOMATONYAN EAU DE PARFUM” plus a tiny tomato icon. Add a dotted circular “NEW” badge on the lower left of the hero area with Japanese product/price text. Add a large handwritten-style Japanese headline near the upper left: トマトにゃん、はじめての香り。. Add smaller Japanese copy above and below it, including a cute heart. Near the bottom center of the hero area, add a short handwritten Japanese message beside tiny paw-print accents.

Bottom left brand strip: Add a full-width muted coral rectangle at the bottom of the left panel. Include a small tomato icon, the large serif brand text “TOMATONYAN”, smaller text “EAU DE PARFUM”, and two short Japanese tagline lines in white.

Right information panel layout: Arrange exactly 6 rounded rectangular cream cards on a pale peach background, separated by clean gutters. Use delicate red-brown serif English headings with tiny paw/flower ornaments and smaller Japanese subtitles. The 6 cards are: 1 “FRAGRANCE” scent notes card, 1 “POINT” recommendation card, 1 “DESIGN” design explanation card, 1 “ABOUT” character story card, 1 “HOW TO USE” usage card, and 1 message card from the tomato cat.

Card details and counts: The “FRAGRANCE” card contains exactly 3 scent note rows labeled TOP, MIDDLE, and LAST, each with a small ingredient icon: tomato for TOP, flowers for MIDDLE, and a pale citrus/wood-like icon for LAST. The “POINT” card contains exactly 4 recommendation rows with circular line icons: handbag, sparkle, heart, and gift. The “DESIGN” card contains a large product photo-style illustration of the tomato-cat perfume bottle plus exactly 2 small thumbnail images underneath/near it: one bottle thumbnail and one tomato-stem close-up thumbnail. The “ABOUT” card contains Japanese explanatory text and 1 small full-body tomato-cat in a cream hoodie at the bottom. The “HOW TO USE” card contains exactly 3 usage icons with Japanese captions: wrist/neck spray, hair/clothing scent, and after-bath relaxation. The message card contains Japanese message text and 1 small tomato-cat in a hoodie on the right.

Visual style: Combine watercolor-like kawaii character illustration with polished cosmetic product photography. Use glossy highlights on the red tomato surfaces and glass bottle, soft shadows on the table, warm beige paper texture, muted coral accents, and elegant brown typography. The characters should look adorable and rounded, with subtle droplets/highlights on the tomato skin. Keep the flyer clean, balanced, and commercial, as if advertising a limited-edition fragrance.

Constraints: English section headings may be used, but most body copy should appear as neat Japanese advertising text. Avoid real-world logos, barcodes, watermarks, or extra characters. Keep the exact visible item counts listed above. The overall palette should be cream, peach, tomato red, warm brown, and leafy green.\

Subject: Profile in the light

Character and Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Fair skin leaning towards bright ivory-beige, with a smooth texture containing a hint of pink. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, and collarbones, with a delicate texture that retains natural skin grain rather than excessive airbrushing. Makeup is precise and elegant, doll-like Japanese style. Features are mature and natural, with a slightly playful and mischievous expression. Head tilted slightly, eyes glancing to the side, showing an exquisite sense of playfulness.

Clothing and Pose:
Dark olive brown satin-style camisole top or thin-strap dress, with a thin ivory sheer wrap loosely draped over the shoulders. Natural chest curves that are subtly visible, creating a mature feminine silhouette. Bottoms are black high-waisted with a slim silhouette. Hair is dark brown in a low loose bun, with thin loose strands around the face and light airy bangs. Sitting diagonally at a wooden counter, holding a highball glass with lemon near the chest with the right hand. Left arm rests lightly on the counter, left hand relaxed on the lap.

Background and Lighting:
Izakaya at night. Warm wooden counter, shelves lined with sake bottles, a deep interior, hanging glass lamps, large windows near the entrance, and blurred seating in the back. The main light source is a warm pendant light above, gently illuminating the upper face, cheeks, nose bridge, shoulders, and collarbones. A faint blue night light peeks through the window, creating depth through contrast with the warm interior. Background figures and tableware are blurred, suppressing them enough to feel the bustle without distracting from the subject. Wooden reflections wrap gently around the skin, creating the warmth of an izakaya and the lingering feeling of the night.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical portrait. Subject placed slightly left of center, a medium shot including up to the upper thighs. Camera at eye level, an intimate conversation distance. Natural field of view around 50mm. Focus on the face and glass, with a soft background blur. The flow of the wooden counter from the bottom right shows depth, naturally conveying the izakaya's atmosphere. A calm yet alluring composition where the upper body is the star.

Texture and Style:
High-quality Japanese photographic style. Realistic skin texture, delicate shadows, natural hair strands, glass transparency, and careful depiction of wood, fabric, and satin materials. Tone is based on warm amber, mixed with a little blue night light for a calm tone. An elegant izakaya portrait with a sense of daily life, atmosphere, and narrative space. Avoid excessive HDR, excessive sharpness, or artificial glowing effects.

Negative:
Infantilization, appearing underage, unnatural face or gaze, collapsed expression, extra or missing fingers, fused limbs, joint failure, poor glass contact, unnatural gravity, excessive exposure, vulgar chest emphasis, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, extreme smoothing, excessive HDR, excessive sharpness, legible background text, logos, watermarks, cheap influencer style, unnecessary prominent people, obvious AI feel.\
